title: Movement (Traffic Control)
basis: R = as printed in the book. Only the org / equipment content of Sec 9 is taken (Reg HQ and Sec Con composn p 914, TC layout and comm p 915, Mil Load Cl p 916, armd div size p 913 para 13); the mov planning pages are listed in otherPages. Fields marked uncertain / judged / *Note carry the reader's doubts.

units.name: TC layout (two routes)

children.note: Four drawn on p 915, two beside each route (Red Route, Green Route); the fourth box is printed "SEC 787" (misprint for SEC CON, a PK 787 beside it).

Traffic posts as drawn on p 915: five along each route, each with a PRC 77 on the MP Net (dotted) and joined along the route by fd cable laid by Div Sigs (dashed). Who mans a TP and its strength are not printed.

notes: Sets drawn on p 915 (on the nodes below, not repeated here): 6x PK 787 (2 at Reg HQ, 1 with each of the 4 Sec Cons) and 14x PRC 77 (1 at each of the 10 TPs, 1 next to each Sec Con). "PK 787" is kept as printed (p 510 also names a "VRC 787"; the set tables p 516-518 list only the PK/PRC-786 HF set).

Diagrammatic Layout and Comm - TC (p 915): Reg HQ between the Red Route and the Green Route (SP at the foot, Rel P at the head of each route). Reg HQ works the Comd Voice Net on a PK 787; a second PK 787 at Reg HQ is joined to the Sec Cons' PK 787s; Sec Cons and TPs work the MP Net on PRC 77.
Legend p 915: solid line = PTCL or Corps Sigs circuits; dashed line = fd cable laid by Div Sigs; dotted line = MP Net. Printed note: "Two circuits by PTCL or laid by Corps".
A diagram for a two-route mov, not an establishment: the numbers of Sec Cons, TPs and sets are as drawn. TC = traffic control (the book does not spell it out).
No Mov / TC unit symbol in Symbols.json; a TP can be shown with the tactical point 25321400 Traffic Con Post (TCP).
